scope: v0.26.5 RC8 attempt 39 supersedes RC7 attempt 38 only to close the final validation gap around the user-visible blank Recomps page. Runtime/model corrections are preserved from the full corrective pass, and the frozen production source 29c4b81ae08eeafc826f0d2d147bcd5733fa870d is green on the same exact SHA across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube. Recomps remains a direct persistent manual EXE library: tile -> RecompsLibrary, Add Recomp Game selects one .exe and appends an independent persistent record, exact saved executables launch directly, removal never deletes files, stale provider-shell states normalize away, and no generic provider/store UI returns. In addition to the existing staged behavioral routing test, the release-shaped candidate must now execute the real WPF renderer from the staged HuymaierRecompsFinal.ps1 before any visual function replacement. The staged WPF paint test must prove the empty Recomps library visibly renders RECOMPS/Recomps, Add Recomp Game, Back to Platforms, Your Recomp Games and the empty-state guidance with two actionable controls; a populated library must visibly render two separate game cards plus Add/Back; and a selected installed game must visibly render Launch, Open Folder, Remove from Recomps and Back. It must also reject recurrence of the PowerShell case-insensitive $Title/$title control-variable collision that caused the blank page. Candidate validation must record stagedManualRecompsWpfPaintGate=success. Preserve HC3D v3 with 80-byte vertices, direct authored/transformed glTF UVs and no hidden V inversion, mirrored winding/tangent repair, base-color plus metallic/roughness/normal/occlusion/emissive maps, multi-UV and texture transforms, sampler wrap modes, correct OPAQUE/MASK/BLEND semantics, textureless authored base colors, generated-model front orientation and opacity, GOG purple GLB -> HC3D -> WARP pixels, single/double-sided culling and GPU mips. Preserve the shared HC3D v3/D3D11 full-screen viewer with HC_GPU_SetShelfItemView/SetItemView and shared brightness. Preserve canonical visible labels without changing emulator routing identities, especially 32X -> Sega 32X plus full Sega/Nintendo/PlayStation and provider branding labels. Preserve V7 native D3D11 shelves, persistent GPU cache, zero bundled GLBs, unified native cursor, streaming, GameCube, downloads/history, provider concurrency, artwork persistence, external foreground apps, installer rollback/tamper behavior, Steam ownership and all frozen PS1/PS2/PS3/emulator-console behavior. The staged platform-model gate must still require HC3D v3, direct glTF UV/material paths, OPAQUE semantics, Sega 32X naming, shared viewer export/control, packaged textureless purple v3 cache with mirrored winding and WARP smoke. Installer fault injection, stabilization, staged cursor/streaming/GameCube/V7, staged behavioral Recomps plus real staged WPF paint, active-download stability, Steam ownership and final SHA verification must all pass. Upload only if the request parent exactly equals production_source 29c4b81ae08eeafc826f0d2d147bcd5733fa870d and every source and packaged gate succeeds.
